newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Russian Sverdlovsk region Eurobond in 3 mths -bank.
newsitem.headline: Russian Sverdlovsk region Eurobond in 3 mths -bank.

text.p: Russia's AB Inkombank, the financial adviser and co-manager on the Sverdlovsk region's forthcoming Eurobond, will prepare draft placement documents for the issue in three months, the bank said on Thursday.
The Sverdlovsk regional administration said it planned to issue a three-month Eurobond for up to $20 million.
WestMerchant Bank is the lead-manager of the issue.
Some other Russian regions and cities, including St Petersburg, Moscow and Nizhny Novgorod, are planning Eurobond issues.
The issues are being held up by the government, which has yet to issue laws outlining the taxation and financial terms of regional Eurobond issues.
